hook.en: Changing a single base in a single gene can turn round red blood cells into sickle shapes. Today we see how such changes run in families.

body.en: A mutation is a change in the DNA sequence that changes the genotype and the phenotype. Loss or gain of a DNA segment, or a change in a single base pair (point mutation, as in sickle-cell anaemia), are examples; chemical and physical agents that cause mutations are mutagens, such as UV radiation. Because controlled crosses are not possible in humans, we study a family tree, the pedigree, to trace a trait over generations.
body.kn: DNA ಅನುಕ್ರಮದ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಉತ್ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆ; ಒಂದು ಕ್ಷಾರ ಜೊತೆಯ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಬಿಂದು ಉತ್ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆ. UV ಕಿರಣಗಳಂತಹ ಉತ್ಪರಿವರ್ತಕಗಳು ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣ. ಮಾನವರಲ್ಲಿ ವಂಶವೃಕ್ಷ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Mendelian disorders are caused by a single gene. Haemophilia and colour blindness are sex-linked recessive, so they are far more common in males; the mother is usually a carrier. Sickle-cell anaemia is autosomal recessive: GAG changes to GUG, so valine replaces glutamic acid at the sixth position of the β-globin chain. Phenylketonuria and thalassemia are also autosomal recessive. Chromosomal disorders come from an extra or missing chromosome (aneuploidy), often due to failure of chromatids to separate. Down's syndrome is trisomy 21; Klinefelter's syndrome is 47, XXY (a sterile male with some feminine features); Turner's syndrome is 45, XO (a sterile female with rudimentary ovaries).
body.kn: ಏಕ ಜೀನ್ ದೋಷಗಳು: ಹಿಮೋಫೀಲಿಯಾ, ವರ್ಣಾಂಧತೆ (ಲಿಂಗ ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಅಪ್ರಬಲ), ಕುಡುಗೋಲು ಕಣ ರಕ್ತಹೀನತೆ, ಫಿನೈಲ್‌ಕೀಟೋನೂರಿಯಾ, ಥಲಸ್ಸೇಮಿಯಾ. ವರ್ಣತಂತು ದೋಷಗಳು: ಡೌನ್ (21ರ ತ್ರಿಸಮ), ಕ್ಲೈನ್‌ಫೆಲ್ಟರ್ (XXY), ಟರ್ನರ್ (XO).

points.en: Down: trisomy 21; Klinefelter: XXY; Turner: XO

problem.en: A woman whose father had haemophilia marries a normal man. What is the chance that (a) a son, (b) a daughter will have haemophilia?

steps.en: Her father gave her his X with the haemophilia allele, so she is a carrier: X^H X^h. Her husband is X^H Y.
Sons get Y from the father and either X^H or X^h from the mother: half the sons are affected.
Daughters get X^H from the father, so none are affected; half are carriers.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A woman whose father had haemophilia marries a normal man. What is the chance that (a) a son, (b) a daughter will have haemophilia?

body.en: Klinefelter has the eXtra X (XXY, 47, male). Turner has Turned one X away (XO, 45, female).
